question: Which LLTO coating retained the most capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5C, how does it compare with the pristine NCM, and why did the 2 mol.% coating lower the rate capability?
rendered:
According to the document, LLTO coated NCM retained about 85.5% capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5C for LLTO-0.5, and 57.2% for LLTO-2. The pristine NCM only retained 56.6% of its initial discharge capacity after 200 cycles.

The 2 mol.% coating lowered the rate capability because it may have increased the thickness of the coating layer, resulting in the suppression of electron transfer process during charge/discharge cycling.
